name: Through the Night
description: Zofia trusts you with a night courier run: retrieve a bandage from the Center crate and deliver it to Nadia by morning. The shipment carries an unusual routing stamp.

stages.description: Accept the night delivery. Take the goods from the courier crate in Center at night.
At night, take bandage from the courier crate near the Center shop.
Deliver 1 Bandage to Nadia Morozova in the morning. Nadia notices a special transport stamp on the bandage delivery.
Return to Zofia for payment before afternoon.

_codex.narrativeIntent: A nighttime bandage delivery exposes special military medical priorities.
implementationNotes: Keep existing center crate, bandage, morning delivery and deadline.
Nadia notices an unusual routing stamp.
_codex.compatibility: _codex is design metadata, not an executable trigger. Keep all original IDs, trigger shapes, rewards, and existing save compatibility. Add runtime support only after implementing the documented systems.
